findings.problem: updateFormSettingsSchema declares collectEmail, allowMultipleResponses, and confirmationMessage as required (not optional). The design's 'omit to leave untouched' merge behavior applies only to the two genuinely optional new fields; the existing PATCH already requires the other three on every call.
findings.fix: Keep responseNotification (z.enum([...]).optional()) and sendConfirmationEmail (z.boolean().optional()) optional as specified; do not loosen the existing required fields.

findings.location: design Decision 4 / Feature B defensive-render table — MULTIPLE_CHOICE
findings.problem: MULTIPLE_CHOICE is labeled 'array', but validateAnswerAgainstQuestion accepts it as either an array or a bare string (isArray ? value : [value]), so a single selection can reach the answer blob as a plain string.
findings.fix: Render defensively for both shapes: Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter(Boolean).join(', ') : String(v). The plain-string catch-all already covers it, but make the handling explicit.

findings.location: design Feature A.1 — owner lookup for immediate notification
findings.problem: The owner lookup selects email without a presence guard. User.email is non-nullable unique in schema.prisma, so the only failure mode is a missing row (already covered by the block's .catch). No correctness issue.
findings.fix: Optional: add if (!owner?.email) return; for symmetry with the digest path. Not required.
